title: NoMercy plugin repository index
description: The document a NoMercy media server fetches from a plugin repository URL.

plugins.description: Every plugin this repository offers. An empty list is valid.

id.description: The plugin's Ulid, identical to the id in its plugin.json. Twenty-six characters of Crockford base32 — the digits and A-Z without I, L, O or U. Not a GUID: IPlugin.Id is a Ulid, and this schema asked for a uuid while every plugin in the catalogue used a Ulid.

name.description: The plugin's name, as it is shown in the catalogue.

version.description: Dotted numeric. This is what the server compares.

downloadUrl.description: A direct link to the plugin's zip. The server fetches it, verifies it against checksum and extracts it; a browser never sees it. Not a bare .dll — a plugin is a folder of assemblies and its manifest, and PluginManager opens the download as a zip archive.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the file at downloadUrl, lowercase hex. Omitting it means the install cannot be verified.
